newsitem.title: UK: Boots opens first Dutch store.
newsitem.headline: Boots opens first Dutch store.

text.p: British pharmacy group Boots Co Plc on Thursday opened its first store in the Netherlands in Rotterdam, marking the start of its overseas expansion trial announced last October.
The Rotterdam store, on two floors in the new Beursplein development in the city centre, will employ around 80 people and trade seven days a week.
Two further outlets will open in Maastricht and Breda later this summer.

Each of the Dutch stores will have a pharmacy, handling prescription and over the counter medicines and also carry baby and personal care products, cosmetics and perfumes. The stores will stock Dutch, international and Boots UK brands, such as its No7 cosmetics and Natural Collection toiletries.
Boots also plans to open five stores in Thailand this summer, and has been looking at moving into Japan.
